releases.notes:
High-performance Apple Silicon optimization suite for **Minecraft 1.21.4 (Fabric)**.

## 🎯 Per-chip scaling now actually applies
The chip is detected **before** the first config load, so tier / RAM-class budgets are registered in time. Previously the config was derived from BASE placeholders and the tier scaling never took effect. Render distances and particle budgets now scale up by chip tier (PRO/MAX/ULTRA), with the physical RAM class as the hard ceiling.

## 🐛 Fixes
- `GcProbe` no longer mislabels the first micro-stutter as **GC-001** (baseline primed from cumulative GC totals).
- `PerformanceRecorder` handles a runtime window shrink correctly.
- `IrisCompat` & `ChipPower` cross-thread statics made `volatile` (data races).
- **PLAYABLE** keeps the world border and far sounds (no hidden gameplay cues).

## ⚡ Performance
- `ParticleManager` max-particle cap check is now **O(1)** (per-tick-resynced counter) instead of scanning every texture-sheet queue on each spawn — the particle-storm hot path.
- Redundant particle distance check merged; `PerformanceRecorder` no longer `synchronized` on its single-threaded path; dashboard layout computed once in `init()`.

## 🗑️ Cleanup
- Removed dead code (`SiliconBenchmark`, `FastMath`, `SpscRingBuffer`, the write-only spike ring, ~12 unused methods). The no-op FastMath settings toggle is replaced with a functional lightmap-throttle toggle.

---
**Requires Minecraft 1.21.4 + Fabric Loader.** The mod version-locks to 1.21.4 and self-disables on any other version.
